name: squishhub
description: SquishHub: the SquishEyez on-chain hub for WAX (Android, Linux and web)

scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.desktop:build: vite build && cd desktop && npm ci && npm run dist
